svg.title: S2 regional kill: Encore against the static baseline
svg.desc: Two line charts over 15 to 45 seconds of scenario S2, 200 drones, seeds 1 to 5. At 20 seconds 20 neighbouring drones are killed. Static baseline nPWC drops to about 0.91 and stays there; Encore climbs back to about 0.97 within 10 to 15 seconds. The largest gap in the picture jumps to about 6.5 to 8.6 metres for the static baseline and stays; for Encore it falls back to about 2.2 to 2.4 metres.

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: S2 · REGIONAL KILL · 200 DRONES · SEEDS 1–5 · MEDIAN AND MIN–MAX

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 20 neighbouring drones die at 20 s. Encore's survivors refill the important slots; the static show keeps the hole.
